electric-violet.$description: Electric Violet — Brand accent — vivid glow halos behind product cards, focus ring washes, decorative shadow tint. Appears sparingly as a soft aura, never as a filled surface or text color

ink-violet.$description: Ink Violet — Link color and ghost-action border — underlined hyperlinks, outlined action borders, link text. The only chromatic text color in the system

press-black.$description: Press Black — Primary action background, heading text, nav backgrounds. Used for filled CTA buttons and the heaviest typographic weight in the system

carbon.$description: Carbon — Universal border color and high-emphasis text. The system draws most structural borders in pure black at hairline weights

paper-white.$description: Paper White — Page canvas, card surfaces, button text on dark fills, inverse text. The dominant background throughout

newsprint.$description: Newsprint — Subtle surface lift — secondary card backgrounds, hover fills, input resting states. One step off white for quiet differentiation

graphite.$description: Graphite — Muted body text, helper text, secondary labels, nav inactive items. The workhorse gray for de-emphasized content

slate.$description: Slate — Secondary heading text, emphasized body copy, card titles. One step lighter than Press Black for sub-headlines

pewter.$description: Pewter — Tertiary text, nav secondary items, metadata. Between Graphite and Slate in the gray scale

ash.$description: Ash — Medium-contrast borders, control outlines, and structural separators. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

smoke.$description: Smoke — Subtle borders, icon stroke at reduced weight, tertiary metadata text

sans-serif.$description: sans-serif — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

gt-alpina-light.$description: Display serif for hero headlines and section titles — the signature typographic choice. Weight 300 at 80px with -0.02em letter-spacing creates a literary, anti-SaaS gravity. No other productivity app uses a light serif at this scale; it positions Fabric as a thinking tool, not a dashboard.

inter.$description: Body, UI labels, nav items, button text, and subheadings. Weight 400 for body, 500 for emphasis, 600 for button labels and strong UI elements. Negative tracking (-0.01em to -0.02em) at larger sizes tightens the geometric forms for a compact, efficient feel.

manrope.$description: Decorative heading weight — appears in badge labels and small-caps-style category tags. Used sparingly to add visual weight without serif gravitas.

system-ui.$description: Micro-copy and icon-adjacent labels. System fallback ensures pixel-perfect rendering for tiny utility text.
